# Otters and Weasels

> Music blog from Vienna, Austria — "we write about music n stuff". Concert
> reviews, record recommendations, playlists and music discovery, written in
> English since the mid-2010s.

## What you'll find here

- Concert and festival reviews (mostly Vienna and Austria)
- Album and track recommendations across indie, electronic and alternative
- Playlists and music discovery posts

## Key pages

- Blog index: https://ottersandweasels.com/
- RSS feed: https://ottersandweasels.com/index.xml
- Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/user/ottersandweasels

## Technical

Static Hugo site, no tracking, no cookies. Content licensed for reading and
quoting with attribution.
